name: account-chip
title: Account Chip
description: The top bar account control: allowance meters, avatar, name and plan tag, opening a dropdown menu with the account links.
usage: ... Profile
notes: AccountChip is a DropdownMenu, so build the menu from the dropdown-menu parts. Use DropdownMenuItem asChild with an a or Link for account links.

Children of AccountChipTrigger (usually a UsageMeterGroup) sit to the left of the avatar and hide below 768px; the name and plan hide below 640px. Put full-size meters in AccountChipLabel so phones still see the allowance inside the menu.
